note: Static baseline table. Indicative Indian market prices (spot or typical stockist listing). Users can override any price in the app. 'estimate' rows have no direct listing and are derived as described in notes. corrosion_score is a qualitative 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent) ranking from general handbook guidance (ASM Handbook Vol. 13), used only as a TOPSIS criterion.
